sections.title: Letter uve doble
paragraphs: The letter is named (uve doble) /ˈdoble be/. Its main sound appears in (web) /ˈweb/, an online network. This letter has three sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, round your lips tightly. Raise the back of your tongue toward the soft roof of your mouth. Let your vocal cords vibrate. For the second sound, press both lips together completely to stop the air. Release it with your voice on. For the third sound, bring both lips close together without touching. Let the air pass smoothly while your vocal cords vibrate. Touch your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In borrowed words from English, say it as in (whisky) /ˈwis.ki/. In Germanic words at the start of a word, say it as in (wolframio) /bolˈfɾa.mjo/. Between two vowels in Germanic words, pronounce it as in (kuwaití) /ku.βajˈti/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not bite your lower lip with your upper teeth as in the English word vine. Spanish never uses that sound here. Keep your teeth away from your lower lip and use only both lips.
